messages.content: I reviewed the Canyon Light confirmations. The room lists both of us, but the spa itinerary only shows my massage. Please reconcile that before we travel.

I found the mismatch. Spa confirmation SPA7714 currently displays only Priya Nair at 11:30 a.m. Saturday, although the booking notes also contain an unlinked 11:45 a.m. massage. The $300 package credit is attached solely to Priya's resort profile. I can ask Canyon Light to link the second service to Anil Raj Nair and confirm how the credit will be divided.
Do that. The 11:45 treatment is Anil's. Also verify whether the credit covers both massages or only mine.

Canyon Light has linked the 11:45 a.m. massage to Anil and reissued the spa itinerary. The package credit may be shared across eligible spa services charged to the room; it is not restricted to your treatment. They currently show $150 allocated to each massage, with any remaining service charge or gratuity due at checkout.
The earlier total mentioned a $280 spa deposit, while the package was described as having a $300 credit. Make sure those are separate and that we are not being charged twice.

Confirmed: the $280 payment is the refundable appointment deposit securing both treatments. It will be released back to the card ending in 6031 after the massages are completed and charged to the room. The separate $300 package credit will then reduce the two eligible treatment charges by $150 each. There is no duplicate spa charge on the account.
Good. Confirm the start times and what we need to do when we arrive at the spa. Then give me the final resort schedule. Do not change the flights or rental car.

The spa confirmed Saturday start times of 11:30 a.m. for Priya and 11:45 a.m. for Anil. Both guests should arrive at the spa reception desk by 11:00 a.m.; photo identification is requested, and intake forms can be completed there. Resort check-in begins at 4:00 p.m. Thursday, though luggage storage and property access are available upon arrival. No flight or rental-car details were changed.
Please put the whole resort portion in one concise schedule, including checkout and the cancellation deadlines that still matter.

Canyon Light schedule, confirmation CL4N82: Thursday, November 11, arrive in Sedona about 1:45-2:05 p.m., leave luggage if the room is not ready, and check in from 4:00 p.m. Friday, breakfast for two is included. Saturday, breakfast for two; arrive at spa reception by 11:00 a.m.; Priya's massage begins at 11:30 and Anil's at 11:45 under SPA7714. The $300 package credit is split $150 per treatment. Sunday, breakfast for two, check out by 11:00 a.m., and depart for PHX at 1:30 p.m. The room remains penalty-free until 6:00 p.m. Arizona time October 28; the $280 spa deposit remains refundable until 5:00 p.m. November 6. Both guest names and treatments now appear correctly.
